article.title: Sliman Mansour: A Life Spent Painting Hope
article.author: Samia Tawil
article.content: The late Palestinian painter Sliman Mansour left the world a precious legacy: an art whose symbolism mourns the longest exile of our age. The post Sliman Mansour: A Life Spent Painting Hope appeared first on MR Online .
